payload.prompt: Totalkostnadene auka monaleg frå januar til februar 2026. Analyser hovudboka og finn dei tre kostnadskontoane med størst auke i beløp. Opprett eit internt prosjekt for kvar av dei tre kontoane med kontoens namn. Opprett også ein aktivitet for kvart prosjekt.

payload.goal: Identify the three expense ledger accounts with the largest increase in amount from January to February 2026, then create one internal project per account named after the account and create one activity for each project.
success_checks: General ledger comparison between January and February 2026 is completed.
Exactly three cost accounts with the largest increase are identified and ranked.
Three internal projects are created, each named after the corresponding account name.
One activity is created for each of the three projects.
Project names match the identified account names.
risk_notes: Sandbox is empty; no ledger data may exist to analyze.
No company/accounting data source is specified for the ledger analysis.
'Kostnadskonto' filtering may require excluding balance sheet and revenue accounts.
Activity creation is requested, but no dedicated task_type exists; treat as project-related follow-up action.
If multiple accounts tie for third-largest increase, a tie-break rule may be needed.
payload.suggested_first_action: Fetch or generate the general ledger and chart of accounts for January and February 2026, then compute account-level increases for expense accounts.
ordered_steps: Query general ledger entries for period 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-31.
Query general ledger entries for period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.
Load chart of accounts and filter to expense accounts only.
Aggregate amounts by account for January and February 2026.
Compute increase = February amount minus January amount per expense account.
Sort descending by increase and select top three accounts.
Ensure project/internal project functionality is available; enable module if required.
For each selected account, create an internal project with name equal to the account name.
For each created project, create one activity linked to the project, using the account name or a generic activity label.
Return the selected accounts, increase amounts, created project IDs, and activity IDs.

planned_endpoints.summary: Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Find employees corresponding with sent data.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
Requires name and departmentNumber.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.
Do NOT include an 'employments' array in POST /employee — employment details go via separate POST /employee/employment endpoint.

For occupation codes (STYRK/yrkeskode): POST /employee/employment first, then GET /employee/employment/occupationCode?nameAndCode=XXXX to find the code, then PUT /employee/employment/details to set it.
Requires customer={"id": customer_id} and projectManager={"id": employee_id}.
startDate is REQUIRED — set to 2026-01-01 or earlier to allow timesheet entries on any date.
If the prompt mentions a project number (prosjektnummer), set number=<project_number>.
isInternal should be false unless explicitly stated as internal project.
For project BUDGET/fixed-price amount, use field name fixedPrice (camelCase) — NEVER fixedprice.
For fixed-price projects, set isFixedPrice=true and fixedPrice=<amount> in the same request.
When prompt explicitly says fixed-price project, set projectCategory='FIXED_PRICE' (or matching enum value from schema if required).

PROJECT MANAGER SETUP: The employee MUST have userType='STANDARD' (not NO_ACCESS) and entitlements granted BEFORE being assigned as project manager. Steps: (1) POST /employee with userType='STANDARD' and dateOfBirth, (2) PUT /employee/entitlement/:grantEntitlementsByTemplate with params employeeId=ID&template=ALL_PRIVILEGES, (3) THEN POST /project.
Requires project={"id": project_id} and activity={"id": activity_id}.
You MUST create the activity FIRST via POST /activity, THEN link it here.
If activity already linked (409), ignore the error and proceed.
If a default hourly rate already exists (409 Duplicate entry), GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=... then PUT to update it.
For fixed rate: hourlyRateModel='TYPE_FIXED_HOURLY_RATE', fixedRate=<rate>.
